page.layout: One page of running text in one column; in the left margin a few small notes; in the right margin a few small notes; headings "21. LVCIVS Romanus." and "22. STEPHANVS Romanus." set in capitals within the text.

main_text.p: it.O Spiritum Christi in hoc pontifice magnum, & euangelio dignum ministrum. Caeterum homo Dei Cornelius, licet in exilium deportatus, regno tamen Christi minime unquam defuit. Quin optimus eius athleta, in veritatis assertione anno Domini 253. Decii mucroni ceruicem, ut ouis mansueta, praebuit. Unde Mantuanus: Incidit in rigidos praesul Cornelius enses.
main_text.head: 21. LVCIVS Romanus.
main_text.p: Lucius Romanus, fidelis in domo Domini seruus, ab infectatore Christiani nominis Gallo Hostiliano in exilium actus, a sancto Cypriano per literas confortabatur. Tandemque eo mortuo, per uoluntatem Dei, Romam reuersus, Ecclesiam salutari doctrina locupletauit, ac paradisum caelestem anno Domini 255. a Valeriano occidi iussus, & in sanguine agni dealbatus, penetrauit.
main_text.head: 22. STEPHANVS Romanus.
main_text.p: Stephanus Romanus, vir per omnia rectus & bonus, atque ecclesiae ministerio dignus habebatur.

Unde optima (inquit Vuicelius) pontificum exempla, nobis ecclesia propofuit, quamdiu uel nominantur tantum Romanae urbis Episcopi. Furente, Galleno iniquo Caesare, Stephanus anno Domini 257. cum multos gentilium ad Christi fidem convertisset, capite mulctatus, cum plerisque aliis, fit ui stima

page.notes: Left and right marginal notes are very faint and mostly unreadable; the marginal bracket near "Unde optima" and a small mark beside "Incidit" were not legible enough to transcribe. The last word of the page ("stima") is cut by the bottom of the scan and is uncertain. Several words in the Latin are doubtful due to the faded print and show-through; "exempla" and "vel nominantur" may be misread, and "fit ui" is partially cut off. Words printed with a long s (s) have been normalised to s.
